A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the performance of HCN is highly affected by the number of users, the number of RBs, the reuse factor and the path loss exponent.
the coverage probability of CCU is a monotonically increasing function of the number of RBs and users while it is a monotonously decreasing function of reuse factor.

, in a HCN with Soft FR, the CCU coverage probability increases with the increase in number of users and the decrease in the number of RBs while the CEU coverage probability decreases with the increase in users and RBs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the coverage probability of a typical user can be enhanced by increasing the number of RBs and users in the network.
the performance of Soft-FR HCNs with a reuse factor D > 1 is significantly affected by the number of RBs and the number of users in a cell.
the coverage probability of CCU is a decreasing function of the number of active users and the number of RBs.
